description: Changes one field of one email of a webinar: the confirmation email or reminder one to five, and either its subject, its heading, its inbox preview line, its body, whether it is switched on, or when it goes out. Take it when a single mail reads wrong. A host says: "The subject of the first reminder still says the old date." It needs the session, the webinar, which email, which field and the new value. The value replaces the whole field, so read the current text first and copy the part you want to keep. It writes on your site and every registrant receives the new version from the next send on. No other email and no page changes. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: fix a mail, change the subject, edit the reminder, mail text

field.description: What to change in that email. One field per call.

fixed_date.description: With field fixed: the send date as YYYY-MM-DD, in the webinar timezone.

fixed_time.description: With field fixed: the send time as HH:MM, in the webinar timezone.

mail_cta_url.description: The link for a one-click register button appended to the after-live reminder emails. Leave it out to keep the current one.

offset_dir.description: With field offset: before the start, after it, or at it.

offset_value.description: With field offset: how many units before or after the start, e.g. 1.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

slot.description: Which email: signup is the confirmation, 1 to 5 are the reminder and follow-up emails.

value.description: The new text for subject, heading, preview or body. For enabled pass 1 or 0. Not needed for offset and fixed.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_email
title: Change one field of one webinar email
